metadatos.title: El jet lag de las aves marinas #Shorts
metadatos.description:
Una pardela cruza el océano y su reloj se queda atrás.

El jet lag de las aves marinas. Una cápsula de Datos y ociosidades: datos verificados contados como historia.

Fuentes:
• Lewin, P. et al. (2026). Rapid longitudinal flights cause time shifts and Sun compass error. Science 394, 520–524. https://doi.org/10.1126/science.adz2542
• University of Oxford (2026). Study finds that long-distance flights can throw seabirds' internal clocks out of sync, causing navigation errors. https://www.ox.ac.uk/news/2026-10-26-study-finds-that-long-distance-flights-can-throw-seabirds-internal-clocks-out-of
• Pembrokeshire Coast National Park. Skomer Island. https://www.pembrokeshirecoast.wales/things-to-do/pembrokeshires-islands/skomer/
• Getty Research Institute. Thesaurus of Geographic Names: Skomer Island. https://www.getty.edu/vow/TGNFullDisplay?english=Y&find=midway&nation=&place=atoll&subjectid=1009194
